req.title: Deleting all tasks leaves empty table
req.statement: The system shall leave GET /tasks/ returning [] after every task has been deleted.
triggers: deleting all tasks leaves empty table

doc.reasoning: R-TASK-035 requires that after deleting every task, GET /tasks/ returns an empty list []. The test suite covers: (1) positive path — delete all 20 pre-loaded tasks one by one and verify GET /tasks/ returns exactly []; (2) negative path — attempt to delete an already-deleted task and verify HTTP 404; (3) boundary path — delete the last remaining task (boundary between non-empty and empty) and verify the transition to []; (4) state-transition — verify intermediate state (non-empty) before final empty state; (5) decision-table — verify that deleting a completed vs incomplete task both succeed with 204. All assertions use exact values to maximise mutation kill rate.

tests.name: test_delete_all_tasks_leaves_empty_list
preconditions: Database contains exactly 20 pre-loaded tasks with ids 1-20
GET /tasks/ returns a non-empty list before deletions
actions: GET /tasks/ to collect all task ids
tests.executable:
import sqlalchemy, os
from sqlalchemy import create_engine
from sqlalchemy.orm import sessionmaker
from app.database import Base
from app.main import app
from app import models
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

DB_URL = "sqlite:///./test_r035_pos.db"
engine = create_engine(DB_URL, connect_args={"check_same_thread": False})
Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine)
Session = sessionmaker(bind=engine)
db = Session()
for row in [
    (1,"Read chapter 5","desc",True),(2,"Book flight tickets","desc",True),
    (3,"Submit expense report","desc",True),(4,"Prepare meeting agenda","desc",False),
    (5,"Write project report","desc",False),(6,"Run unit tests",None,False),
    (7,"Fix login bug","desc",False),(8,"Prepare meeting agenda",None,False),
    (9,"Pay electricity bill","desc",True),(10,"Organize desk",None,False),
    (11,"Water the plants","desc",False),(12,"Review pull request",None,False),
    (13,"Buy groceries","desc",False),(14,"Buy groceries",None,False),
    (15,"Renew gym membership",None,True),(16,"Fix login bug","desc",False),
    (17,"Call the bank",None,False),(18,"Reply to emails",None,False),
    (19,"Schedule dentist appointment",None,True),(20,"Reply to emails","desc",False)
]:
    db.add(models.Task(id=row[0],title=row[1],description=row[2],completed=row[3]))
db.commit(); db.close()

import app.database as _db
_orig_url = _db.SQLALCHEMY_DATABASE_URL
_db.engine = engine
_db.SessionLocal = Session

def _get_test_db():
    s = Session()
    try: yield s
    finally: s.close()

from app import main as _main
_main.app.dependency_overrides[_db.get_db] = _get_test_db
client = TestClient(_main.app)

r = client.get("/tasks/", params={"limit": 1000})
assert r.status_code == 200
tasks = r.json()
assert len(tasks) == 20
for t in tasks:
    dr = client.delete(f"/tasks/{t['id']}")
    assert dr.status_code == 204
r2 = client.get("/tasks/")
assert r2.status_code == 200
assert r2.json() == []
_main.app.dependency_overrides.clear()
os.remove("./test_r035_pos.db")
